schema_format: This descriptor is human-readable contract documentation (field tables + rules), NOT itself a machine JSON Schema. The machine-checkable JSON Schema (2020-12) for a capture manifest is embedded below as manifest_json_schema; validators run that object, not this file as a whole.
scope: Phase 79 omp protocol evidence and scripted fixtures (RPC-79-1..RPC-79-4, OQ-520..OQ-524): how a capture of omp frames or command output is recorded so every ledger fact in docs/architecture/omp-19-reverification.md traces to bytes. File records under tests/Autonogrammer.Harness.Rpc.Tests/TestData/frames/ and tests/Autonogrammer.Harness.Acp.Tests/TestData/frames/ only; no database, no schema DDL, no production code change in Wave 1. No live model turn (OD-07): captures are version/help output and handshake/scripted-peer frames only.

artifact_shape.capture: A capture is a pair of files with one stem: <stem>.ndjson (or <stem>.txt for command output) plus <stem>.manifest.json conforming to the manifest fields below.
artifact_shape.stem: <transport>-<evidence_label>-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>, e.g. rpc-observed-19.1.1-20261123T201500Z. Capture_id equals the stem.
artifact_shape.frames_file_bytes: The .ndjson file holds omp frame bytes verbatim, one JSON value per line, LF line endings, UTF-8, no envelope and no injected metadata fields. The frame wire format is unchanged from the 18.x fixtures (rpc-out.ndjson, rpc-live-20261021T171351Z.ndjson, acp-in.ndjson, acp-out.ndjson); this contract adds the sidecar manifest only.
artifact_shape.legacy_v0: Existing 18.x fixture files without a manifest (including the .turns.json sidecar of rpc-live-20261021T171351Z) remain valid legacy fixtures labelled verified-18.12.6 by their evidence document (docs/runbooks/evidence/omp-rpc-live-variants-2026-10-21.md). Absence of a manifest never invalidates a legacy file; new Phase 79 captures MUST carry one.
artifact_shape.manifest_location_note: Manifests ride to test output with their frames: Autonogrammer.Harness.Rpc.Tests.csproj copies TestData/frames/*.ndjson AND TestData/frames/*.manifest.json (Content, PreserveNewest; glob widened by A05 in the Phase 79 fixture task), and Autonogrammer.Harness.Acp.Tests.csproj copies TestData/**/* (None, PreserveNewest). Tests may read manifests from output or source tree; both are the same committed bytes.

manifest_fields.name: contract_version
manifest_fields.notes: Contract version the manifest was written against. Manifests written as 1.0.0 remain conforming under 1.0.1 (clarifications only: credential-key definition, embedded machine schema, location note; no field added, removed, retyped or made required)

manifest_fields.name: capture_id
manifest_fields.notes: File stem shared by the manifest and its frames/output file

manifest_fields.name: captured_at
manifest_fields.notes: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z suffix) of capture start, second precision or finer

manifest_fields.name: evidence_kind
manifest_fields.notes: One of frames (NDJSON frame capture), command_output (verbatim stdout of a non-session command such as --version or --help, OQ-524)

manifest_fields.name: omp_version
manifest_fields.notes: Verbatim trimmed `omp --version` output from the same binary and PATH resolution, recorded at capture time. Never inferred from frame content.

manifest_fields.name: evidence_label
manifest_fields.notes: AC-301 label: observed-19.1.1 when omp_version is 19.1.1, verified-18.12.6 for the 18.12.6-verified legacy surface, otherwise observed-<omp_version>. Derived from omp_version, never asserted independently; a mismatch fails validation.

manifest_fields.name: omp_binary_path
manifest_fields.notes: Resolved binary path via the production resolver (OmpLocator, T-79-02), home prefix redacted to ~ (rule R1). PII-indirect.

manifest_fields.name: argv
manifest_fields.notes: Exact argument vector passed to the omp process, argv[0] the binary as invoked, after redaction rules R1-R2. PII-indirect (paths) and secret-bearing values are redacted before commit, never recorded raw.

manifest_fields.name: live_model_turn
manifest_fields.notes: Must be false for every Phase 79 capture (OD-07, plan prohibition). A manifest with true is out of contract for this milestone wave.

manifest_fields.name: frames_file
manifest_fields.notes: Path of the .ndjson (evidence_kind frames) or .txt (command_output) file relative to the manifest

manifest_fields.name: frames_sha256
manifest_fields.notes: sha256 over the exact committed bytes of frames_file AFTER redaction. Recomputing sha256sum over the committed file must reproduce it; it digests the redacted fixture, never a raw capture.

manifest_fields.name: frames_bytes
manifest_fields.notes: Byte length of the committed frames_file

manifest_fields.name: frame_count
manifest_fields.notes: Line count of frames_file. For evidence_kind frames it must equal the frames index length; for command_output the frames index is empty and frame_count is the output line count.

manifest_fields.name: redaction_applied
manifest_fields.notes: True when any of R1-R5 changed a byte of frames_file or any argv/path value recorded in the manifest

manifest_fields.name: redaction_rules
manifest_fields.notes: Rule ids applied, subset of R1..R5 below; empty array only when redaction_applied is false

manifest_fields.name: ledger_refs
manifest_fields.notes: Ledger row / open-question ids this capture evidences (e.g. OQ-520, OQ-524) in docs/architecture/omp-19-reverification.md. Non-empty: a capture evidencing no ledger row must not be committed (79-CONTEXT D-02).

manifest_fields.name: frames
manifest_fields.notes: Per-line index, frame_fields below, in file order. Empty only for evidence_kind command_output.

frame_fields.name: direction
frame_fields.notes: in (omp stdout to client), out (client to omp stdin), or stderr. Direction is from the client/harness point of view.

frame_fields.name: t_offset_ms
frame_fields.notes: Monotonic milliseconds from process spawn to the completed line read/write; preferred over per-frame wall time. Non-decreasing within one direction.

frame_fields.name: frame_type
frame_fields.notes: RPC: top-level `type` value of the line. ACP: JSON-RPC method for requests/notifications, `result`/`error` marker plus id correlation noted as result:<id> for replies. stderr lines use the literal stderr.

frame_fields.name: byte_length
frame_fields.notes: Byte length of the line excluding the LF terminator

frame_fields.name: line_sha256
frame_fields.notes: sha256 over the line bytes excluding the LF terminator, after redaction

frame_fields.name: redacted
frame_fields.notes: True when a redaction rule changed this line

frame_fields.name: redacted_paths
frame_fields.notes: JSON Pointer paths replaced in this line; required non-empty when redacted is true and the line is JSON

redaction_rules.rule: Absolute home-directory prefixes in argv values, omp_binary_path and JSON string values are replaced with ~; other absolute paths stay only when they are evidence (resolved binary path, cwd) and contain no username.

Secret-bearing argv values are replaced with the literal <redacted>. An argv item is secret-bearing ONLY when (a) it is a name=value or --name=value item whose name (leading dashes stripped) is a credential key per credential_key_definition below, or (b) it is a flag whose name is a credential key, in which case the following item (its value) is replaced. Metadata flags whose names merely contain 'token' (e.g. --max-tokens=4096) are NOT secret-bearing. Secrets are never recorded, hashed-then-kept, or committed in any form.

JSON object members at any depth whose key is a credential key per credential_key_definition below AND whose value is a string have the value replaced with <redacted> and the JSON Pointer recorded in redacted_paths. Token-metadata keys are never credential keys under that definition (maxTokens, tokenizer, tokensPerSecond etc. carry model/usage metadata, not credentials) and must be left verbatim — redacting them would corrupt the protocol evidence.

Prompt/message text in scripted captures is synthetic scripted-peer input only (no real user text, no live model turn). Any accidentally captured non-synthetic text is replaced with <redacted> under R3-style path recording, and the capture is re-taken scripted if the text was load-bearing evidence.

Raw unredacted captures are never committed. They live only in the capturing session's scratch space and are deleted once the redacted fixture and manifest are frozen (retention: session-local). Committed redacted fixtures are retained as test data with the phase history.

privacy.masking: frames.payload (PII-direct, prompt/message text) is synthetic-only under R4 and redacted under R3; manifest.argv and manifest.omp_binary_path (PII-indirect) are redacted under R1-R2. Masking happens before commit in every environment; there is no unredacted committed form to unmask.
privacy.retention: Raw captures: session-local, deleted at fixture freeze (R5). Committed redacted fixtures + manifests: retained as test data. No personal-data store, table or subject-request surface is created by this contract.

validation_rules_for_consumers: V1: recomputed sha256 of frames_file equals frames_sha256 and its length equals frames_bytes; frame_count equals the file line count.
V2: frames index seq is exactly 1..frame_count; each line_sha256/byte_length recomputes from the committed line.
V3: evidence_label is the derivation of omp_version stated in the field note; any other pairing is rejected (AC-301: 0 unlabeled or mislabeled facts).
V4: live_model_turn is false; ledger_refs is non-empty and every id resolves to a row in docs/architecture/omp-19-reverification.md or an OQ-520..OQ-525 row.

V5: redacted frames carry non-empty redacted_paths; no committed line or argv value holds a credential key (credential_key_definition exactly — word-boundary segments and the explicit key list, never a bare 'token'/'key'/'secret' substring scan) with a string value other than <redacted>. Token-metadata keys (credential_key_definition.never_credential_examples, e.g. maxTokens, tokenizer, tokens, tokensPerSecond, requiresGlyphTokenization as observed in the 19.1.1 get_state frame) are out of scope for this check and their presence unredacted is NOT a finding (QF-102).
V6: frame_type matches the line it indexes (RPC top-level type; ACP method/reply marker), so a fixture cannot silently drift from its index.

credential_key_definition.purpose: Single matcher shared by R2, R3 and V5. It replaces the 1.0.0 loose substring wording (key|token|secret|password|authorization), which false-positived ordinary omp token-metadata keys observed in real 19.1.1 frames (QF-102). Producers and validators implement exactly this definition, never a substring scan.
credential_key_definition.normalization: Lowercase the key and delete every '_' and '-' (so access_token and accessToken both normalize to accesstoken). CamelCase word segments are the key split on '_', '-' and lower->Upper transitions, lowercased (maxTokens -> [max, tokens]; requiresGlyphTokenization -> [requires, glyph, tokenization]).
credential_key_definition.is_credential_key: A key is a credential key iff EITHER its normalized whole form is in exact_keys, OR (segment rule) some segment is exactly one of [secret, password, passwd, passphrase, authorization], OR its segments contain the consecutive pair [api, key], OR its LAST segment is exactly 'token' (singular). Additionally the member value must be a string for R3/V5 to fire; numeric/boolean values are metadata, not credentials.
credential_key_definition.worked_examples: Credential: apiKey (pair api+key), accessToken / refresh_token (exact + last segment token), clientSecret (segment secret), authorization (exact), openaiApiKey (consecutive segments api,key). NOT credential: maxTokens (segments [max,tokens]; plural, not exact), tokenizer / tokenization (single segment, not 'token'), tokens / tokensPerSecond (plural/usage), tokenCount (last segment count), cacheKey / publicKey / sortKey ('key' alone is never a credential segment).
credential_key_definition.extension_rule: A newly observed credential-bearing key is added to exact_keys by a BACKWARD 1.x contract revision naming the capture that evidenced it; implementers must not improvise broader local patterns.

manifest_json_schema.title: OMP19 protocol evidence capture manifest
manifest_json_schema.x-not-expressible-in-schema: Cross-field rules V1-V6 (digest recomputation, evidence_label derivation from omp_version, line/seq correspondence, credential-key scan) are validator logic on top of this schema; passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient.

Legacy v0 fixtures without manifests remain consumable.
